items.content_html: A modular, reproducible pipeline that tests whether biological images can be grouped by species without training labels. It extracts features using foundation models, runs multiple unsupervised clustering methods, and evaluates clustering quality using ground-truth species labels. It also helps to annotate the clusters using BioCLIP-2
